# The Agentic Web

> A specification for AI-native company endpoints. Instead of letting AI agents
> scrape SEO-shaped marketing pages and guess, a company exposes an MCP server at
> /mcp that answers questions with verified first-party data and lets the agent
> take real actions on the company's behalf.

Open specification, maintained by Salespeak (https://salespeak.ai/). Not
enterprise-only: the profile is meant for any business with a website, from a
bakery to a SaaS company.

## The idea

Today an AI agent scrapes the web and presents a mix of marketing copy and
hallucination as objective truth, with no way for the reader to verify it or act
on it. An agent that queries each vendor's own endpoint instead gets
apples-to-apples, attributable answers.

Two pillars:

1. Verified Responses — the vendor answers agent questions directly with
   authoritative, current, citable data (security certifications, pricing tiers,
   integrations, SLAs), and can ask qualifying questions back. The exchange is a
   conversation, not a one-way lookup.
2. Possible Actions — the agent can complete tasks, not just read: schedule a
   demo, open a support ticket, request a quote, start a trial.

## How it works

1. Expose a profile — stand up an MCP server at https://yourcompany.com/mcp
2. AI discovers — agents find it and learn what you can answer and do, via the
   standard MCP `initialize` handshake and `tools/list`
3. Interact — users get verified answers and complete actions through conversation

Transport is JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP. Any MCP-compatible client works;
there is no per-agent integration. Tools commonly exposed: `ask_question`,
`schedule_demo`, `open_ticket`, `request_quote`, `qualify`. Access is anonymous
by default. The specification page covers required, optional, and custom tools.

## Pages

- [Home](https://agentic-web.ai/): The idea, the two pillars, and a worked example.
- [Specification](https://agentic-web.ai/specification.html): MCP Server Profile — JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP transport, tools, verification, qualification, and the access model.
- [NLWeb and the Agentic Web](https://agentic-web.ai/nlweb.html): How this extends NLWeb with B2B capabilities — structured discovery, qualification loops, action endpoints, verified responses.
- [Interaction sequence](https://agentic-web.ai/sequence.html): Step-by-step sequence diagram of an MCP-enabled conversation between agent, user, and vendor.
- [Why it's good for everyone](https://agentic-web.ai/why.html): The value for buyers, vendors, and the models themselves.
- [Under the Hood (blog)](https://agentic-web.ai/blog/): Technical walkthrough with JSON-RPC 2.0 examples, for any business becoming an AI-native endpoint.
- [Agent-to-agent chat](https://agentic-web.ai/a2a-chat.html): A live A2A conversation — agents negotiating pricing, capabilities, and integrations for a buyer.
- [Agent-to-agent sequence](https://agentic-web.ai/a2a-sequence.html): How agents negotiate on behalf of buyers and sellers.
